build_magnet_solver: build a MAGNeT solver to train a non-autoregressive transformer for masked audio generation
run_magnet_training_step: run a single training step of the MAGNeT solver on a batch of audio tokens
create_spans_mask: create a spans mask with configurable masking rates and atomic span length for MAGNeT training
compute_cross_entropy_magnet: compute cross entropy loss for a specific codebook stage during MAGNeT model training
build_audio_magnet_solver: build an AudioMagnetSolver to train a MAGNeT model for sound generation tasks
